review_candidates.title: Deloitte Innovation Hub I Information Security GRC Lead
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Your primary responsibilities will include Internal Governance Enforcement maintaining and updating the DIH internal Information Security Management System (ISMS) to ensure the adherence of the Deloitte standards and regulations. Promote a strong security and data privacy culture helping teams to understand their role and responsibility in protecting Deloitte brand and business. 7+ relevant years of experience.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Hands-on experience evaluating AI/ML infrastructure or algorithmic risk is required. 7+ relevant years of experience. Practical, hands-on experience implementing ISO/IEC 27001 controls and managing evidence collection for internal and external audits. Preferred certification: CISA, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Internal Auditor and AI-specific credentials like the Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP). Connect to your business – Technology & Transformation Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, and collaborative working. Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing.
